notes.content: This is the entirely handwritten continuation, authorially numbered 2., of a letter discussing a mathematical manuscript. The p.19 comment describes the proofs of lemmas 4.3 and 4.4. The p.26 entries promise a reference, discuss irreducibility in the Zariski topology, and request mention of the points s-prime. The p.33,34 entry concerns proposition 7.4. The p.43 entry reports dissatisfaction with the form of theorem 9.4 and mentions constant fibres with arbitrary crossings. The p.45 entry asks whether an indication is sufficient. The lower half offers to add an appendix on Lefschetz theory and requests typing instructions and a deadline, explaining that a carbon copy is retained. The closing reads With best regards, Sincerely yours, followed by J.P. Mu with an uncertain terminal rre. These are the author's remarks, not mathematical conclusions established in this reading.
